apps.note: Live with independent hosted CI, SHA-tagged images and separate web, worker, gateway and rollback-web deployment targets. See registry/operations.json for workflows; no self-hosted runner is required. The PAGES moved to /projects/policy-analysis on 2026-09-13; /api/policy-analysis did not. The bare /policy-analysis claim is still here on purpose — the app answers it with 308s, and the share lane under it is public under BOTH prefixes because a share token handed out before the move is a URL somebody else holds and an anonymous visitor cannot log in to reach a redirect. Main keeps the rest of /projects: the claim is /projects/policy-analysis and its children, never /projects/policy-analysis-other.

Drive owns the routed browser/file/share APIs. WebDAV was REMOVED entirely on 2026-09-13 rather than routed here: the two webdav_credentials this file previously called "real mounts" were both created and last used on 9 May, minutes apart — a connection test — with no /dav request in fourteen days of application logs or seven of cloudflared's. webdav_credentials keeps its declaration because an undeclared table is a dropped one. /api/drive/folders and /capture remain Main-owned Intelligence surfaces. Drive hands Intelligence work through drive_intel_outbox. Main and Drive still share file storage and some writers.
apps.executionOwner: Drive HTTP requests; Intelligence outbox consumer remains Main-owned

apps.note: Landgrab is DEFERRED and stays in Main this wave, and that takes ALL of src/lib/geo and /api/geo with it: /api/geo/rebuild is the territory rebuild, reading daydream_trail and the landgrab ledger, and it is the only geo consumer anywhere in the health trees. So there is no geo split to make — Health is health + trails + their components. /api/health/workflow-engine is Main's event-loop probe, excluded back to Main; the VPS watchdog unit was repointed to /api/platform/workflow-engine on 2026-09-13. /health EXACTLY is the public landing and every /health/* child is owner-only. Strava and WHOOP callback URLs are registered with those providers and pass through unsigned.
apps.executionOwner: Health HTTP requests; hourly Strava/WHOOP scheduler remains Main-owned

apps.note: Planned only. Step 0 inventory done 13 September 2026 against SR-Main #876; see docs/JKAI-CORE.md. The domain is three pages and 45 endpoints — every other /jkai page belongs to a Main domain. paths carries /api/workflows/orchestrator/chat because the chat transport lives there, not under /api/jkai. The three open decisions were settled 17 September: /jkai/canvas stays in Main and calls the chat transport across (it carries a browser session, so the gateway signs an identity for it); /api/jkai/memory travels with chat, because chat writes jkaiMemories and Main reads it across; and the invoke contract runs on a split credential with the destructive lane shut by default — SR-Main's POST /api/platform/tools/invoke, deliberately NOT under /api/jkai, since this prefix is routed away. excludePaths covers the APIs of the excluded pages and not only the pages, including /api/jkai/tools: the build bridge and promote_ephemeral_tool are Main's forge, and routing them here would hand Main's own tool catalogue to the chat application.
